component.name: RillDisk
component.summary: See what fills your disks and what you can safely free

description.p: RillDisk is a fast, read-only disk usage analyzer. It scans a drive or folder, shows where the space went as a treemap or rings chart, and points out build output, caches, old worktrees and other things you can safely remove, each with an explanation and a command you can run yourself.

It never deletes, moves or uploads anything. Partial scans and unreadable folders stay visible, and logical, unique and allocated sizes are kept apart. The same scanner powers the rilldisk command line and a local MCP server for AI assistants.
